title: Approval of Agreement No. 47044 for Proprietary Professional, Technical,
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Agreement No. 47044 for Proprietary Professional, Technical,
  and Repair Services and Parts with GE Vernova International, LLC. The term
  of the Agreement spans five years from the date of execution, with a
  budgeted not to exceed amount of $250,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Approve five-year professional, technical, and repair services agreement with GE Vernova International for power system operations with a budgeted amount of $250,000,000.
